- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended suspension upgrade options include: coilovers, sway bars, springs, shocks, and bushings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider before making upgrades: vehicle's intended use, driving style, budget constraints, and compatibility with other modifications.
- [EVENT] User is looking into coilovers for their car.
- [PREFERENCE] User has heard good things about KW Suspension and Öhlins but is open to other options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a rundown of pros and cons for KW Suspension and Öhlins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KW Suspension pros: wide range of applications, adjustable damping, high-quality materials, and affordability.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] KW Suspension cons: not as highly adjustable as Öhlins, less bespoke options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Öhlins pros: highly adjustable, bespoke options, high-performance focus, exceptional build quality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Öhlins cons: higher cost, limited applications, steeper learning curve.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other brands to consider include Bilstein, JRZ, MCS, and AST.
- [PREFERENCE] User has heard good things about JRZ coilovers, especially their ability to provide a smooth ride on the street while delivering great handling on the track.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant confirmed that JRZ offers coilover options suitable for autocross and track events.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] JRZ coilover options mentioned: JRZ RS, JRZ RS Pro, and JRZ 2-way.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] JRZ RS is designed for high-performance street driving and track use with adjustable compression and rebound damping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] JRZ RS Pro offers advanced damping technology and is designed for serious track enthusiasts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] JRZ 2-way features separate compression and rebound damping adjustment for fine-tuned control.
